name: Intracranial Tumor Segmentation Challenge
description: Evaluates automatic segmentation of intracranial tumors on brain MRI to support radiosurgery planning.
evaluation_method: Dice coefficient (DSC) primary, Hausdorff distance and IoU as secondary
reputation: Well‑established international challenge in medical imaging with wide participation and public leaderboards; commonly used in research on brain tumor segmentation.
notes: Non‑LLM vision benchmark using multi‑institutional MRI data; moderate dataset size with annotation variability and inter‑rater differences; clinical deployment requires further validation despite high leaderboard scores.
